 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor User as User
 participant UI as React Frontend
 participant API as FastAPI (/v1/chat)
 participant Ast as Assistant Core
 participant WF as Chat / Agent Workflow
 participant Mem as FileMemory
 participant LLM as LLM Provider (Groq / Local / Mock)

 UI->>API: POST /v1/chat/stream (SSE)
 API->>Ast: execute_stream(request)
 Ast->>WF: run_stream(input_text)
 WF->>Mem: add_message(role=\"user\", content=input_text)
 WF->>Mem: get_history()
 Mem-->>WF: Role-Based Message History
 WF->>LLM: generate_stream(messages)
 loop SSE Streaming Response
 LLM-->>WF: Stream Chunk
 WF-->>API: Yield Chunk (SSE Event)
 API-->>UI: Data Stream (Chunk)
 UI-->>User: Live Typing Indicator Output
 end
 WF->>Mem: add_message(role=\"assistant\", content=full_response)",
